description: Separate a song at a public URL into stems. This is a PAID action via x402, settled in USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet): call once WITHOUT `payment` to receive payment requirements, then call again WITH the x402 `payment` receipt to start the split. Returns a job_id; poll get_split_result for the stem URLs. If the paid endpoint is switched off, the call returns an error; people can split in the browser at https://stemconsole.ai/ instead.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file to split.

filename.description: Optional filename hint if the URL has no audio extension.

model.description: vocals = Vocal Remover (2 stems: vocals, instrumental); fast = Basic Split (4 stems: vocals, drums, bass, other); full = Full Separation (6 stems, adds guitar and piano).

payment.description: x402 payment payload (base64 X-PAYMENT). Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: split_audio
title: Split a song into stems (paid via x402)
